prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic, high contrast, saturated colour with a bright white-hot core, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot; do not copy its background, its board, its gems, its cards, its heroes, its boss or any part of its layout. One single gout of molten lava is breathed downward through the frame, from a tight throat at the top centre out into a broad cone that fills the bottom edge corner to corner. It is one breath in one beat: the fire leaves the throat once, never in puffs, never in a second burst, never two overlapping cones. The gout is thick and liquid — lava, not gas: fat tongues of molten orange that tear off their own edges into flying globs and droplets, ragged spitting rims, thin dark crusts skinning over the slowest tongues and breaking apart again, never a smooth gas flame, never a clean airbrushed gradient, never a smoke plume, never a cloud. A gold-white core burns down the middle of the gout, hottest at the throat and cooling to deep orange out at the tongues, and a faint orange heat glow sits just around the whole cone. It surges to its brightest about a third of the way in, holds wide open, then chokes off at the throat first, so the top of the frame empties while the last of the lava falls away past the bottom edge and dies. Nothing is left at the end. There is exactly one breath in the whole clip: no second gout, no repeat, nothing before it and nothing after it, and it is finished well before the clip ends. The effect is alone on a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green studio backdrop — a seamless green studio cyclorama, the same solid green from edge to edge, and nothing else is in frame: no floor, no room, no landscape, no wall, no rock, no creature, no monster, no head, no jaw, no teeth, no mouth, no character, no smoke, no dust, no haze, no atmospheric glow, no shadow cast on the green. The green is a plain backdrop and is never lit by the effect: it does not brighten, glow, flicker, darken or change colour anywhere, not even directly behind the fire, and no green light spills onto the lava, which stays orange and gold-white and is never tinted green. The cone stays centred, fills the frame and is never cropped at the sides. Square frame. Single continuous shot, one fixed locked-off camera, no cuts, no shot changes, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear.
